deadline.value: Apply by February 1 to be eligible for internal awards. Year inferred.
deadline.quote: Students who submit applications by February 1st will be eligible for internal awards.

supervisor.value: You can apply without one, but an offer needs a supervisor willing to take you into their lab.
supervisor.quote: In order to be offered admission to our graduate program you will need to meet the minimum academic requirements and have a supervisor who is willing to offer you a position in their lab.

funding.value: Minimum PhD stipend CAD 24,000 a year on the Centre's page; Queen's guarantees full-time PhD students at least CAD 25,000 a year in 2026-27.
funding.quote: Current minimum stipends are $21,000/year for an MSc and $24,000/year for a PhD.

also.quote: For the 2026-27 academic year, our full-time PhD students will receive a guaranteed minimum funding package of $25,000 a year

entry_route.value: A master's in neuroscience or a field with a strong neuroscience and research component is required.
entry_route.quote: The minimum requirement for admission into the Ph.D. program is a master’s degree in Neuroscience, or in a field with a strong neuroscience and research component.
